newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends down in quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends down in quiet session.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,162 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,170 *
Open/hi/low 1,166/1,169/1,161 Prev close 1,170
Prev settlement 1,164 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower in thin volume ahead of a long holiday weekend. Market lacked direction after recent volatility due to absence of fresh leads. January contract seen trading between 1,150 and 1,180 in near term.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Very quiet with few trades done. Prices were little changed.
Traders said players were also consolidating their positions after the recent volatility.
The market is now focusing on official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's crop figures for October, to be released next week, they said.

Third position January crude palm oil futures closed at 1,162 ringgit ($461.11) a tonne after trading in a eight ringgit range. Traders expect the contract to trade between 1,150 and 1,180 ringgit in the near term.
Volume on the futures market was 685 lots against 2,242 lots on Thursday.
Physicals prices were little changed with few trades done.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit ($464.29) a tonne with bids at 1,167.50, after trading at 1,170.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,155 with bids at 1,147.50, and traded from 1,155 to 1,150.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,145 and bids at 1,137.50.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,180 ringgit with bids at 1,175. It was traded between 1,172.50 and 1,182.50.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,170 and bids at 1,162.50.
Among refined products, Nov RBD palm olein was offered at $537.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $535. Nov was traded at $537.50.
Nov RBD palm oil was offered at $500, Dec at $497.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $500.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $367.50 and Dec at $372.50.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $305.
